author: hdprajwal
abstract: Send synthetic keyboard and mouse input on Wayland/Hyprland: wtype for keyboard (rootless, no daemon) and ydotool for the mouse (with the one-time uinput udev rule + input-group + ydotoold setup spelled out). Covers typing, key combos, absolute/relative mouse moves, clicks, double-click, drag, and the logical-vs-physical coordinate conversion. The hands for visual computer use. Verified on CachyOS + Hyprland.
